name: Ebb and Flow
notes: The bonus scales linearly with missing mana: none at full, the full bonus at empty. With Living Mana, mana regeneration is your health regeneration, so this is a comeback orb. Casting down to 1 mana also maxes the bonus, but one hit at that point kills you. The percentages are suggested starting values, left for tuning.
summary: Your Mana Regeneration increases the lower your mana is.
